recipes.name: Cucumber Salad With Sour Cream
ingredients_raw: salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Place cucumber slices in a container and cover with cold water. Refrigerate 4 hours to overnight.
Whisk sour cream, sugar, vinegar, and salt together in a large bowl until sugar dissolves.
Drain cucumbers well and pat dry with paper towels. Add cucumbers to sour cream dressing and toss to coat.

raw_recipe.headline: Cucumber Salad With Sour Cream
raw_recipe.description: This tangy cucumber salad with sour cream makes for a deliciously creamy and refreshing vegetable holiday side dish or summer salad.

review.reviewBody: This recipe has been in our family for over 40 yrs. But my goodness, whats with all of the sugar. This is not dessert. Less is more ! Also WAY TOO much sour cream , a goodly dollop will do. Also I always add garlic powder to give it the best flavor. Otherwise it is a great recipe. (from my precious Hungarian mother in law).

Delicious cucumber salad! I put a little salt in with the water so I didn't have to let this sit overnight. It works with or without dill (did half and half). The dressing is very good, the perfect mixture of sweet and tart.

I make a very similar Cucumber Salad but instead of soaking overnight I peel, slice super thin into a colander over a bowl and sprinkle generously with salt. Put a bowl or dish on top of the cucumbers to press out the liquid. Let stand for a good hour or more. Mix up your dressing in the meantime--I always add fresh dill 1/3 cup or so and Fresh parsley also about 1/3 cup or so. Sugar to taste. I like to let the dressing and drained cukes meld so usually make this in the morning for an evening meal. Delicious with Steaks and Baked potatoes!!---I usually do my potatoes by slicing them into thick disks and inserting onion between each disk. Sprinkle with seasoned salt and fresh cracked pepper, then drizzle with olive oil right into the foil packet. throw on the grill for 45 - 60 min---so deelish!
I forgot to add that it works best if you peel the cucumber beforehand. Thanks for the great reviews!

This is a tasty recipe for cucumbers. I made two changes; I only used 2 teaspoons of sugar and 3 teaspoons of vinegar. Otherwise it would be too sweet. There is no need to soak the cucumbers for 4 hours. Add salt to them and let soak in a colander for an hour.

Very, very good! II made this without any changes, using a scant 1/3 cup of sugar, and adding a few thin sliced onions. I have a feeling this will be a staple around here this summer. Would be great to take to potlucks! Delicious!

I wish I could give this more stars. The first time I followed the recipe exactly. Now I double the number of cucumbers, and add thinly sliced Vidalia onions. Great way to use up a garden full of cucumbers. thank you tarawvu for a great recipe.

I followed the recommendation by another reviewer to salt the cucumber slices and then rinsed them and blotted them dry. As far as the dressing, I added the sugar a little at a time, taste testing as I did so, and used more like 1/4 cup instead of 1/2 cup. I also used less sour cream, about 3/4 of the 8-ounce carton, and about 1/3 cup of vinegar. This recipe is a classic for the ingredients and their ratio. My husband's comment was that he wouldn't change a thing. Thank you TaravWu, for a delicious way to enjoy summer cucumbers!

Have people that made the recipe slice the cucumbers real thin? Add sugar to taste, 1/3 C is way too much unless you want a real sweet dish. Salt cukes and let sit for 20 minutes, rinse and pat dry to keep crisp. Very thinly sliced onion added is a nice touch. I’m a more “non measuring exactly” type cook so after putting the sour cream in a bowl, I’d taste the mixture as I go along. Just suggestions.
Way too much sugar! Try 1 tsp rather than 1/3 cup. Luckily I had extra sour cream so I could start over.

Too sweet! I cut the sugar back to about a teaspoon and the sour cream to a generous tablespoon. I also added some thin-sliced scallions. Good quality dried dill will do, but fresh is much better. Letting it marinate for several hours is important if you want the cucumbers to pick up all of the flavors.
Was too sweet for me. And too thin. Too much liquid.
Prepared without Sugar. Fresh and body beneficial!
Great recipe for a summer favorite. I substituted white wine vinegar and it was delicious! I also added a little fresh dill at the end.
Made it and substituted rice vinegar for regular vinegar. It was delicious and with all the cucumbers we have, we'll have it again!

I made it with 1 English cuke. I used Rice Vinegar with the sour cream, some chopped red onion & a sprinkle of dried Dill. Plus a touch of fresh ground black pepper. No salt. The rice vinegar is already sweet, so no need for sugar.
Tasted awful. Too much sugar. Disappointed.
Way too much sugar, I add garlic, red onion and dill
I got this recipe 45 yrs. ago from my MIL, I would never think to add sugar let alone 1/3 cup!
I did add pickled onions to your recipe. Fantastic! Next time I'll have to make a double batch. Everyone asked for more.
